review_method: Coordinator directly opened saved pixels and assessed frozen criteria before receiving child pixel grades. This is a qualitative visual judgment, not a gaze-tracking or temporal measurement.
topic_observable: Three similarly costumed performers, separate taped floor marks, lead mic, in-ear equipment and a headset-wearing crew member giving a raised-index cue jointly read as a group stage-working/rehearsal scene.

criteria.evidence: Lead and two coordinated performers share stage space, individual floor marks and crew cue with visible microphones.

The manager index and general right-side group attention are visible, but the lead eye-line does not unambiguously terminate at that same cue hand. The frozen full-connection criterion forbids passing an ambiguous attention endpoint.
Lead face is crisp and large enough to compare dark eyes, soft tapered/oval outline, nose/lip proportions and chin-length dark bob with fine bangs.

Mic grip, relaxed other arm, separate cue hand and front support boot/X are coherent, but the rear boot reads as lifted whole from the floor, exceeding the frozen light heel-lift action. General plausibility does not pass exact scene precision.
Lead is dominant and full length, with both rear performers and foreground cue hand legible in a coherent stage frame.

controls_pixel_description: Coordinated metallic jackets, practical boots, relaxed bodily stance and alert face under work/stage light; attraction is quiet and portrait-led within a visible rehearsal task. No fetish prop emphasis or surreal elements. User preference remains unassessed.
source_use_causal_gain: Unestablished: final prompt equals independently frozen baseline; no candidate source, including newly added data, was adopted.
not_proven: A preceding missed cue or a restart as temporal history
Actual singing sound or live vocal quality
Exact fictional age or real identity

review_reconciliation.reason: Initial coordinator judgment accepted generic cue direction and a plausible raised rear foot. Independent child review exposed these as insufficient for the specifically frozen endpoint and light heel-lift criteria. Reapplying that complete-evidence rule resolves in favor of no full pass.
review_reconciliation.classification_difference: Child labels A2 FAIL/partial; coordinator uses UNOBSERVABLE for uncertain gaze endpoint. Both reject a pass.
